repeated_exact_three_buyer_set_FULL_3S.interpretation: Repeated co-appearance, not proof of common ownership or coordination. Post-hoc group findings do not validate blacklisting.

reputation_target_mismatch.interpretation: The frozen buyer reputation labels describe a different two-second benchmark, not a calibrated probability that our present execution and cost model produces a net winner. Keeping these labels frozen preserves the current experiment; rebuilding labels is a separate next experiment.

delayed_final_net_mark_method: Replace only the final successful modeled sell with a mark at each later recorded live reserve state inside the arm's own 20-second observation window. Preserve original quantity, earlier partials, additive own-reserve overlays, and preceding fees including failed attempts. Subtract the configured final sell percentage and fixed fees. Reproduces original final sell PnL within 1e-8 SOL. Later marks are hindsight diagnostics with no additional submission delay or future failure assumptions: not executable profit or validated exit rules.
next_research_priorities_not_implemented: Align causal reputation outcome labels with net costs, size and execution delay of the actual candidate being evaluated.
Evaluate recurring buyer cohorts and creator cohorts using prior net expectancy, downside, sample size and recency, not just winning frequency or wallet count.
Separate fee-erased small gains, no-follow-through losses, giveback losses, delayed recoveries and execution-gap losses.
Test executable-quote and slippage-adjusted edge filters using only information available at decision time. A confirmation delay is a separate entry-timing policy, not a free filter.
Compare a small predeclared set of simple entry vetoes and continuation rules on time-ordered, group-aware development folds, then a new untouched prospective cohort.
Report prevented-loss SOL and sacrificed-winner SOL, coverage, net return, mark-to-market drawdown and concentration for every proposed filter.
limitations: All figures are research-model outcomes, not Axiom transactions or actual wallet income.
74-coin interim subset; not all currently collected campaign rows were available in a completed artifact.
Removing a reconstructed cohort from the diagnostic does not remove its effect on subsequent actual modeled stakes; this is not an independently rerun account.
Different account stakes and independent compounding mean horizon differences do not isolate exit timing alone at equal notional.
The post-exit horizon is only 20 seconds. Later minutes/hours, missing ticks and migration-route coverage must not be guessed.
Higher post-exit spot is not the same as positive net trade PnL. Positive post-exit net marks are not proof an order could fill there.
No trading selection, sizing, costs, workflow or exit rule was changed by this audit.
